field.label: Max Tool Response Tokens
field.comment: Tool output larger than this estimated token count is truncated before it is sent to the AI, so one large result cannot crowd out the conversation (default: 4000).

field.label: Allow reindexing
field.comment: Lets the assistant queue a full reindex of one or all indexers. On large catalogs this can load the server for a long time. Requires the async.operations.all consumer to be running.
